leftEvidence.title: All things created and held together

points.label: Creation setting
points.left: Creation is revisited through a Christ-centered claim about origin, purpose, and continuity.
points.right: The Gospel deliberately places creation vocabulary at its opening without retelling Genesis 1 scene by scene.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Creation through and for Christ · Heaven · earth · Create · hold together · Visible · invisible
points.right: Word with God · Word is God · All things made through the Word · Life · light · darkness · Creation language at Gospel opening

payload.posture: Both texts locate all created things in relation to the preexistent Christ or Word.
payload.tension: John opens through life and light in narrative proclamation; Colossians expands across visible, invisible, thrones, and continuing coherence.
payload.title: All things through Christ / all things through the Word
